'''Reykos''' was the most common beast on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Volik]]. It was a docile herd animal similar to a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]]. They were covered in a hard shell-like skin that made the creatures appear like many of the large boulders that covered the planet's landscape; this camouflage aided them in hiding from predators. Their primary source of food was the grass that they shared their home with. They were hardy and impervious to [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire. Often, they were used as beasts of burden.<ref name=":Mask of Darth Nihilus" />
